headline: Kenya Fuel Dealers Threaten Buying Freeze Over Wholesale Pricing Violations
summary: Independent petroleum dealers in Kenya threatened to stop buying fuel from major marketing companies, alleging wholesale sales exceed maximum statutory ceilings set by regulator EPRA.
why: Independent petroleum distributors supply vast retail networks across East Africa; disruptions can cause severe transportation and logistics bottlenecks.

impacts.name: Fuel Distribution Kenya
impacts.why: A boycott of wholesale petroleum purchases threatens regional fuel distribution and retail availability.
